title: Device Failure / Outage
description: Emergency triage for completely unresponsive network devices, power disruptions, or service crashes.
steps: Execute out-of-band management console ping and IPMI power check
Inspect physical rack power supply units (PSU) and PDU breaker status
Verify adjacent switch/router uplink LED status
Check out-of-band serial console for kernel panic or hardware crash dumps
Escalate to Network Hardware Engineering if hardware failure is confirmed
